name: Is natural stone tile actually worth it, or does it just look nicer?
description: It is worth it if you want a distinctive, upscale look and are okay with some upkeep. The main value is the natural variation, durability, and visual character.

mainEntity.name: Is natural stone tile actually worth it, or does it just look nicer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Natural stone gives a unique, high-end look because no two pieces are exactly alike, and it can add character that manufactured tile cannot copy. It is a strong choice if you want a more natural appearance and are comfortable with a little more maintenance.
